summary: United Launch Alliance's Vulcan rocket suffered a mission failure. Forty Amazon Leo internet satellites were destroyed. This setback delays Amazon's Starlink competitor.

headline: Milburn Report Recommends National Insurance Cut for Under-25s

headline: Zelensky Calls for Starlink Restrictions Lift
summary: Ukrainian President Zelensky urges the US and Elon Musk to remove Starlink limitations. He states slowed internet hinders defense against Russian attacks. Appeals for support to be on the 'right side of history'.

headline: UK Gains 'Voice' but No Vote on EU Food Rules
summary: Britain will influence EU food policy discussions post-Brexit. However, the UK will not have a voting right on new regulations. EU Minister Hamish Falconer confirms this new deal arrangement.
